title: Top Of The Dunes | KEY.co
description_expanded: With its spacious layout, this vacation home comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests across its five bedrooms and five-and-a-half bathrooms. The sleeping arrangements include a luxurious King bedroom, two Queens, a double bunk bedroom, a bunk bed with a trundle, and a convenient sleeper sofa. The first floor encompasses two bedrooms, a Queen room with a bunk bed and trundle, a sleeper sofa, a cozy living area, and a full-size washer/dryer. On the second floor, you'll find a serene King bedroom, a half bath, a well-appointed kitchen, a dining area, and a welcoming living room. The third floor features a delightful Queen bedroom with a private deck and a charming double bunk bedroom. Each bedroom comes with its own private bathroom and smart TV for added comfort and entertainment. The main living room offers an open and inviting space, seamlessly connecting the kitchen, dining area, and living room. The kitchen boasts a convenient walk-in pantry, perfect for storing all your culinary essentials. Ample closet space ensures that you can easily keep your belongings organized during your stay. Take in the breathtaking views and soak up the sun from the decks on every level of the home. The community itself offers two sparkling pools within a short walking distance, while the pristine beach is just a quick stroll away.
